messages.content: Please check the weather in Tokyo, then book flight AA100 for Alice Chen in economy. Also look up the Hilton Tokyo and prepare an available room request for a standard room there for Alice Chen from 2025-09-10 to 2025-09-14. After that, check AAPL’s current price, use that quote to set up and place a sell order for 3 shares, and get the USD to EUR exchange rate. Finally, check the status of my living room light with ID light_living, get its current mesh snapshot, and publish that snapshot in the app for user u_alice with high priority.
